title: Tables and Data Grids
summary: Tables enable precise record comparison; grids add editing and keyboard complexity.

MUST.text: Use semantic headers (`<th scope>`) and an accessible table name/caption; associate row and column headers.
Provide keyboard operability for sortable headers (button + aria-sort) and focusable interactive cells.
Handle empty, loading and overflow states; do not trap horizontal scroll.

SHOULD.text: Align numeric values; expose sorting state and units; use tabular figures.
Prefer a real table for comparison data; paginate or virtualize large sets.

AVOID.text: Do not turn comparison data into cards when cross-row scanning matters.
Do not use layout tables for data or div-soup for tabular data.

DECIDE.decision: Horizontal scroll container or careful card fallback

EXAMPLE.good: Invoice table: Invoice, Due date, Amount, Status; amount right-aligned; sortable Amount header announces sort

FAILURE_MODES: Div-based tables lose header association and assistive-tech navigation.
Unannounced sort state confuses screen-reader users.
Horizontal overflow without a scroll affordance hides data on mobile.
